summary: Preview an access list denied page

200.description: The page as HTML (text/html), with sample values filled in

404.description: The place shows no page of its own, or the id does not exist

description:
Returns the page an access list shows to a refused visitor, as HTML with sample values. The answer is 404 when the list does not exist or shows no page of its own.
Needs: an administrator (a token needs its Administrator switch)
